 Indian Railways Announces New Delhi–Patna Reserved Festival Special Train: Check Timings and Route 
 Indian Railways Indian Railways Announces New Delhi–Patna Reserved Festival Special Train: Check Timings and Route
 Edited By : Ameya Sathaye Published : November 12, 2026, 7:47 PM IST   |   Updated : November 12, 2026, 7:48 PM IST   |   17 
 Share 0 
 Indian Railways will operate Reserved Festival Special Train 04068/04067 between New Delhi and Patna Junction to clear the additional festive-season rush. Train 04068 will depart New Delhi on November 13, 2026, while its return service, 04067, will depart Patna Junction on November 14, 2026. The train will have AC, Sleeper and General coaches.
 Key Highlights
 Train numbers: 04068 (New Delhi–Patna) and 04067 (Patna–New Delhi).
 Departure from New Delhi: November 13, 2026, at 7:00 PM.
 Departure from Patna Junction: November 14, 2026, at 6:00 PM.
 Coach composition: AC, Sleeper and General.
 New Delhi–Patna Reserved Festival Special Train
 New Delhi, Nov 12: To manage the additional passenger rush during the festive season, Indian Railways has announced a Reserved Festival Special train between New Delhi and Patna Junction.
 The special service will provide additional travel options for passengers travelling between the national capital and Bihar. The train will operate in both directions on November 13 and 14, 2026.
 The train will have AC, Sleeper and General coaches.

 How to Check Train Status and Updates
 Passengers can check the latest information about the New Delhi–Patna Reserved Festival Special through the National Train Enquiry System (NTES) or by calling the railway enquiry helpline 139.
 Passengers are advised to check the latest train running status before commencing their journey.
 The New Delhi–Patna Reserved Festival Special (04068/04067) will provide additional reserved travel capacity during the festive rush. With AC, Sleeper and General coaches and stops at major stations across Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, the service is expected to facilitate passenger movement between Delhi and Patna.
